meta.name: dev-ralph
meta.description: Persistence loop — keep working on a task until it's resolved or until a circuit breaker stops you. Different from /loop (which is time-based) — ralph is iteration-based with state.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 反复执行任务直到完成或中断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要一个自动重试直到成功的循环工具
copy.tagline_en: Keep retrying a task until resolved or stopped
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a loop that retries until success or break

howto.what: Claude 会反复执行同一任务，每次基于前一次结果调整，直到任务完成、达到 5 次上限或连续 3 次相同失败才停止。每次迭代会记录尝试内容和失败原因。
howto.when: 当任务有明确的完成信号（如“测试通过”），但不确定需要迭代多少次时触发。常用于“修复直到测试通过”这类自动修正循环。

say.text: 请反复测试这段代码，直到所有测试通过。
say.note: Claude 会迭代测试并记录每次结果。

say.text: 继续修复这个 bug，每次告诉我做了什么尝试。
say.note: Claude 会累积状态，避免重复无效操作。

say.text: 循环运行构建直到成功，最多 5 次。
say.note: 达到上限或连续失败会停止并报告。

howto.what_en: Claude repeatedly executes the same task, adjusting based on previous results, until completion, reaching 5 iterations, or encountering 3 identical failures. Each iteration records what was tried and why it failed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task has a clear completion signal (e.g., 'tests pass') but an uncertain number of iterations. Ideal for auto-correcting loops like 'fix until tests pass'.

say_en.text: Keep testing this code until all tests pass.
say_en.note: Claude will iterate and log each result.

say_en.text: Continue fixing this bug, tell me what you tried each time.
say_en.note: Claude accumulates state to avoid redundant attempts.

say_en.text: Loop the build until success, max 5 times.
say_en.note: Stops on limit or repeated failures and reports.
